ALTER TABLE jobs ADD COLUMN citation_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0

CREATE TABLE inspection_citations (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	job_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	review_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	document_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	document_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	manufacturer VARCHAR(180) NOT NULL, 
	revision VARCHAR(180) NOT NULL, 
	applicability TEXT NOT NULL, 
	page INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	excerpt TEXT NOT NULL, 
	excerpt_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	relevance TEXT NOT NULL, 
	added_by_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_inspection_citation UNIQUE (job_id, review_id, page, excerpt_sha256), 
	FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES jobs (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(company_id) REFERENCES companies (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(review_id) REFERENCES source_reviews (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(added_by_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
CREATE TRIGGER citations_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON inspection_citations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION feniq_snapshot_immutable()
